# FAQ (from the website)

Q: Which ZUGEE products can I use today?
A: Every product shown on this page is ready to use today. Book a demo and we will arrange a meeting to show you the product working before you decide.

Q: Can I use more than one ZUGEE product?
A: Yes. Each ZUGEE product is separate software with its own login and its own data, built for one kind of business. You can use two or more side by side, and we set up each one for you.

Q: What is the one-time setup fee?
A: It covers setting up ZUGEE around your business: your business profile, users, branches, workflows and first data, plus a walkthrough and onboarding support. You pay it once, when you start. The amount depends on the product and how much setup your business needs, and we share the exact figure on a short pricing call.

Q: Do I pay the setup fee again every month?
A: No. The setup fee is charged once per product. After that you only pay the subscription for that product, which depends on the product, the number of users and the number of branches. We confirm your exact pricing on the call, before you decide.

Q: My industry isn't listed. Can ZUGEE still help?
A: Choose "Something else" in the form and tell us what you need. We will tell you honestly whether one of our products fits.

Q: Can I still use Tally alongside ZUGEE?
A: Yes. ZUGEE handles your daily operations, billing and customer management. Your chartered accountant can continue using Tally for statutory filings and audits. We can export the data your accountant needs in a format they can work with.

Q: Where is my business data stored?
A: Your business data is stored securely and can be accessed only by the authorised users in your organisation. We share hosting details on request; just ask us on your demo call.

Q: Does ZUGEE support WhatsApp notifications?
A: WhatsApp Cloud API integration is currently rolling out. Once live, ZUGEE will send invoices, payment reminders, booking confirmations and dispatch alerts directly to your customers on WhatsApp. This feature is actively being built but not yet available. Book a demo and we will share the latest timeline.
